Subject to approval by the Major Programmes concerned, students may opt out of the Double Major Programme and register for the 1st Major Programme only. The decision to opt out is irrevocable. Students who have opted out are required to complete and fulfill all graduation requirements by following the study scheme of the 1st Major Programme as a single major. Students should be aware that such decision may result in a delay in graduation because the requirements of the single major study scheme differ from those of the Double Major Programme.

For those students who have chosen TRAN4900 Translation Thesis, the language used in writing the thesis should be different from the target language of their translation project for TRAN4510/4520 (e.g. if the student writes the TRAN4900 thesis in English, s/he must take TRAN4510 Translation Project: English-Chinese for Final Year Project).

sections.title: Faculty Package

subsections.title: 1st Major: Translation
text: Students are required to complete 27 units of elective courses from the following list of courses, including at least one course from each of Electives Cluster A and Electives Cluster B

subsections.title: Four courses chosen from the three areas below, with at least one course from each area

text: Language and Culture, and Linguistic Applications BMBL1001[a], 1002#, 3002#, 3003#, LING2301, 3208, 3401, 3403, 4402

sections.title: Research Component/ Capstone Course/ Final Year Project

notes.text: TRAN courses at 2000 and above level as well as those labeled as # will be included in the calculation of Major GPA for honours classification.

Students may be required to participate in activities such as field trips and study tours that foster their learning of linguistics. Students are responsible for part of or all the costs incurred in relation to these activities.

Students are encouraged to learn a modern language or take courses in a discipline relevant to a translation area in which the student would like to specialize after graduation using their free electives.

Subject to approval by the Major Programmes concerned, students may opt out of the Double Major Programme and register for the 1st Major Programme only. The decision to opt out is irrevocable. Students who have opted out are required to complete and fulfill all graduation requirements by following the study scheme of the 1st Major Programme as a single major. Students should be aware that such decision may result in a delay in graduation because the requirements of the single major study scheme differ from those of the Double Major Programme.
If the course is not taken to fulfill requirement 1, it may be taken as an elective course for fulfillment of requirement 3(b)(iii).
The course not taken to fulfill requirement 2(b) may be taken as a free elective course.
Translation Major student who pursues a second Major in Linguistics can be exempted from taking LING3401 by taking TRAN2610. Units earned can be counted towards both Major Programmes.
